faultLoc.explanation: The NullPointerException is thrown because the code attempts to call `booleanValue()` on a `null` element in the `array`. This line does not handle the case where `array[i]` is `null`, leading to the exception.

This line starts the loop that iterates over the `array`. If any element in the `array` is `null`, the subsequent line (9267) will throw a NullPointerException. The loop does not include a check for `null` elements.
